articles.title: Mets Get Major Mark Vientos Injury Update After Three-Homer Game
articles.summary: The New York Mets have received some big injury news regarding Mark Vientos ahead of their upcoming series against the Tampa Bay Rays. The post Mets Get Majo...
articles.body:
The New York Mets are playing out the string of what has been a massively disappointing 2026 campaign. After entering the year with playoff expectations, the Mets are sitting at the bottom of the National League East division with a 61-76 record heading into play on Monday. While there are still games to play, the team's attention has been turned to the upcoming offseason.

Still, New York is looking for any silver linings it can find before the season comes to a close. Ahead of its upcoming series against the Tampa Bay Rays, the Mets appear set to get a nice injury boost, as third baseman Mark Vientos is expected to be activated off the injured list after tearing it up during his rehab assignment at Triple-A.

Mets Set to Activate Mark Vientos From the Injured List

Vientos is one of several players who have played a big role in New York's disappointing season. A former top prospect, Vientos seemed to enjoy a breakout campaign in 2024 when he hit .266 with 27 home runs and 71 RBIs in 111 games. Besides that season, though, Vientos has been a below-average third baseman for the Mets.

That has continued in 2025, as Vientos has been borderline unplayable for New York. Through 73 games, Vientos is hitting just .211 with 11 home runs and 35 RBIs, while also playing subpar defense at third base. Simply put, Vientos has been a mess, and the Mets have some big decisions to make regarding his future with the team moving forward.

Part of what makes Vientos' struggles so frustrating is that he has the upside to be an All-Star slugger, as he showed over the weekend when he hit three home runs in the Syracuse Mets' 8-0 win over the Lehigh Valley IronPigs. With that game in the books, New York believes Vientos is ready to return to the majors, as he is meeting the Mets in Tampa, indicating his activation from the injured list is imminent.

Mark Vientos is in Tampa with the Mets following his 3-HR game Saturday and is expected to be activated soon," Jon Heyman of The New York Post reported in a post on X.

Mets Hoping Mark Vientos Can Finish the 2026 Campaign on a High Note

Again, there isn't much left for the Mets to play for this season, but individually, Vientos has a lot to prove. Changes are coming for New York this offseason, and this may be Vientos' last chance to prove he can be a part of the team's long-term future. The front office may have already made up its mind about him, but a strong finish to the year could change things.

Vientos could be activated as soon as Monday, depending on how quickly the team can conjure up a corresponding move, but regardless, it seems like he will be back on the field in the near future. New York will kick off its series against Tampa Bay at 6:40 p.m. ET on Monday, and all eyes will be on Vientos to see if he ends up being in the team's lineup for the game.

NFL teams are allowed to have 16 players and can carry a 17th if the extra is from the league's International Pathway Program.

A maximum of six players on the squad can have NFL experience.

articles.title: Carson Hocevar Heads Into the Chase With High Hopes
articles.summary: Carson Hocevar is officially headed to the Chase. The Spire Motorsports driver has earned a spot in the 16 driver NASCAR Cup Series postseason field followin...
articles.body:
Carson Hocevar is officially headed to the Chase.

The Spire Motorsports driver has earned a spot in the 16 driver NASCAR Cup Series postseason field following a strong regular season that included the biggest win of his young career. Hocevar enters the Chase with plenty of momentum and a chance to compete for his first Cup Series championship.

Hocevar broke through earlier this season at Talladega Superspeedway, earning his first career Cup Series victory in a thrilling finish. The 23 year old held off Chris Buescher by just 0.114 seconds to capture the win and prove he could compete with the sport's top drivers.

The victory was part of an impressive season for Hocevar, who has consistently shown speed at superspeedways and other tracks. He also recorded strong finishes at places such as Michigan and EchoPark Speedway, regularly putting the No. 77 Chevrolet near the front of the field.

Hocevar's aggressive driving style has occasionally gotten him into trouble, but it has also helped establish him as one of NASCAR's most exciting young drivers. His ability to make bold moves and race aggressively could become a major factor during the Chase, where every position and point will matter.

The regular-season finale at Daytona was a difficult night for Hocevar. He was running near the front late in the race before getting loose while battling Ryan Preece for second place. Hocevar hit the wall and collected Erik Jones, ending his night with five laps remaining.

Despite the disappointing finish, Hocevar's season has already established him as a legitimate contender.

With the Chase beginning, Hocevar will have the opportunity to turn his breakout season into a championship run. He has already proven he can win at NASCAR's highest level. The next challenge is showing that he can consistently perform when the championship is on the line.

For Hocevar and Spire Motorsports, this is a chance to take another major step forward and potentially announce themselves as a championship threat.

articles.title: Carlos Alcaraz Returns to Tennis With Statement Win at US Open
articles.summary: After almost five months away from tennis, Carlos Alcaraz is back like he never left, winning his first-round match at the US Open by defeating Roman Safiull...
articles.body:
After almost five months away from tennis, Carlos Alcaraz is back like he never left, winning his first-round match at the US Open by defeating Roman Safiullin in straight sets.

Entering the match with doubts over his match fitness, the Spaniard looked very much like the player he was before his wrist injury . He cruised into the second round while extending his winning streak at the Majors to 15 consecutive matches.

Just like in his mixed doubles match, Alcaraz showed some signs of rust early on, facing break points in the opening stages. However, it felt like facing and saving those break points woke the Spaniard up. From there, he began to build momentum.

Alcaraz eventually became the first player to break serve, with that advantage proving enough to win the opening set. The second set saw Alcaraz drop his serve early on, but remarkably, the Spaniard maintained his composure and quickly got back on serve. The World No. 3 then went a break up himself, producing a sublime forehand performance, a shot that was under the most doubt coming into the match.

Shortly after, Alcaraz went up two sets to love, a position from which he has never lost a match in his career. With the roof closed for the third set, Alcaraz took some time to adjust to the new conditions, again fending off a couple of break points. By that point, however, the Spaniard had started to grow increasingly confident from the back of the court. That confidence quickly paid off as he went up a break in the third set.

And that was all she wrote. Returning from the biggest physical setback of his career to date, Alcaraz put together an impressive performance to reach the second round of the US Open.

Entering the US Open with lower expectations than usual, the defending champion has begun his campaign tremendously. He wasted no extra time on court and looked increasingly comfortable as the match progressed.

Considering his performance, along with his chief rivals Novak Djokovic and Arthur Fils already suffering early upsets, it increasingly looks like another Major title could be on the cards. It would certainly be one of Alcaraz's more unlikely Slam triumphs. However, if the Spaniard can hold up physically, it is becoming increasingly difficult to rule him out.

articles.title: Aaron Glenn makes stunning QB2 admission as Jets decision takes shape
articles.summary: New York Jets have made their decision on who will serve as Geno Smith’s backup quarterback, with rookie Cade Klubnik earning the role following a strong pre...
articles.body:
New York Jets have made their decision on who will serve as Geno Smith's backup quarterback, with rookie Cade Klubnik earning the role following a strong preseason.

Jets head coach Aaron Glenn told reporters that Klubnik will be the team's No. 2 quarterback, giving the fourth-round pick a significant role behind Smith.

Aaron Glenn confirms Cade Klubnik as Jets' QB2

Klubnik's performances during the preseason have impressed the Jets coaching staff, helping him emerge as the preferred option for the backup job.

The rookie had already caught Glenn's attention with his showing in the Jets' opening preseason game against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.

Klubnik completed 5-of-7 passes for 56 yards in that contest and appeared comfortable operating the offence. Glenn was particularly impressed by the quarterback's confidence and ability to make plays with his legs.

"When we watched him in college, he was the same way," Glenn said postgame. "Nothing changes. He has some moxie to him. He's very confident. He's confident in his arm. He's confident in his ability to elude and make plays with his feet.

"And his ability to be able to come out and operate with the first group the way he did, to me, I thought was outstanding. Still some things that he has to learn, still mistakes that he made in the game, but listen, he's going to be quick to correct those, just like the other players are. We're going to continue to move forward."

Klubnik was once viewed as a potential first-round pick before his final season at Clemson changed his draft outlook.

The Jets ultimately selected him in the fourth round, and his preseason performances have now earned him the opportunity to begin his NFL career as Smith's primary backup.

Glenn's decision represents a significant vote of confidence in the rookie as the Jets finalise their quarterback room.

articles.title: Eagles GM Howie Roseman: All four QBs have value to us, won't name No. 2 at this point
articles.summary: The Eagles' backup quarterback job was the subject of plenty of speculation over the course of the summer, but the team ended up passing on a decision to get...
articles.body:
The Eagles' backup quarterback job was the subject of plenty of speculation over the course of the summer, but the team ended up passing on a decision to get rid of either Tanner McKee or Andy Dalton.

Both quarterbacks made the initial 53-man roster and the Eagles also kept rookie Cole Payton, who saw time on special teams in addition to playing his regular positions during the preseason. All three are behind Jalen Hurts and the rationale for keeping four quarterbacks was the subject of the first question General Manager Howie Roseman fielded during a Monday press conference.

"Most important position in sports," Roseman said. "I feel like all those guys have value for our team. Obviously some is short-term value, some is long-term value when you think about Cole."

Roseman was also asked about how the quarterbacks fit into the depth chart, but declined to say who will be Hurts' backup in Week 1.

"Anything that goes into preparations for Washington, we're going to keep close to the vest," Roseman said.

The Eagles will release a depth chart before Week 1, but their inactive list may wind up being the best guide to who they will turn to if Hurts has to miss any time this year.

articles.title: Detroit Lions Sign Promising Offensive Lineman to Practice Squad
articles.summary: The Detroit Lions are bringing offensive lineman Mason Miller back on their practice squad after his impressive debut at center in the preseason finale.
articles.body:
The Detroit Lions are bringing offensive lineman Mason Miller back on their practice squad , according to Nolan Bianchi of The Detroit News .

Detroit waived Miller Sunday while setting its initial 53-man roster, but after he cleared waivers Monday, the Lions wasted little time getting the versatile offensive lineman back in the building. Detroit's official cutdown announcement listed Miller among the players waived Sunday.

Miller's return makes plenty of sense after what he did in Saturday's 25-16 preseason victory over the Indianapolis Colts .

With Detroit severely shorthanded at center, Miller was thrown into a position he had virtually no experience playing.

Bianchi noted that Miller had an excellent debut at center against Indianapolis, giving Detroit another option behind a position group that has already been hammered by injuries.

The Lions entered the finale without Cade Mays, while Seth McLaughlin had been dealing with a concussion. That emergency situation forced Miller into the middle after Detroit had spent much of camp evaluating him elsewhere along the offensive line.

We recently looked at the uncertainty surrounding Detroit's center situation entering Week 1 , with Juice Scruggs positioned to handle the starting job while Mays recovers.

Miller now gives the Lions another developmental option who has already shown he can step into the middle in a pinch.

Detroit ultimately kept nine offensive linemen on its initial 53-man roster , leaving Miller on the outside despite his strong finish to the preseason.

He may not have survived the initial cut to 53, but after what Miller showed against Indianapolis, keeping him around was an easy decision.

articles.title: Denny Hamlin Enters the Chase as the No. 1 Seed
articles.summary: Denny Hamlin is entering the 2026 NASCAR Cup Series Chase with one of the best opportunities of his career to finally capture his first championship. The Joe...
articles.body:
Denny Hamlin is entering the 2026 NASCAR Cup Series Chase with one of the best opportunities of his career to finally capture his first championship.

The Joe Gibbs Racing driver will lead the 16 driver postseason field as the No. 1 seed after putting together a dominant regular season. Hamlin officially clinched the top seed following his seventh place finish at New Hampshire Motor Speedway. He enters the Chase with a 25 point advantage over Ryan Blaney.

Hamlin's regular season was highlighted by an impressive three-race winning streak. He picked up victories at Nashville Superspeedway, Michigan International Speedway and Pocono Raceway, establishing himself as one of the strongest drivers in the series heading into the postseason.

Consistency has also been a major reason for Hamlin's success. After 26 regular-season races, he finished with 1,027 points before the championship reset. That reset puts him at 2,100 points to begin the Chase, giving him the largest starting advantage in the 16 driver field.

Now, Hamlin will try to turn that regular-season success into a championship.

The 2026 Chase will feature 10 races, beginning with the Southern 500 at Darlington Raceway on September 6. Hamlin has already shown that he can perform well at several of the tracks coming up on the schedule, making him an early favorite to make a deep championship run.

For Hamlin, the pressure is especially high. He has built one of the most successful careers in NASCAR without winning a Cup Series championship. Despite multiple championship appearances, the title has continued to elude the veteran driver.

This year, however, Hamlin enters the postseason with momentum, experience and the No. 1 seed.

The Chase will ultimately determine whether he can finish the job. With a strong Joe Gibbs Racing team behind him and a 25 point cushion to start the postseason, Hamlin has put himself in an ideal position.

Now comes the biggest challenge: finally bringing home the championship that has escaped him throughout his legendary career.

articles.title: JCPS cancels outdoor activities amid forecasted extreme heat
articles.summary: Student athletes are encouraged to check with their coach or athletic director for adjusted times and cancelations.
articles.body:
Jefferson County Public Schools officials have canceled all outdoor practices and competitions Sept. 2-3 due to forecasted extreme heat, according to an Aug. 31 post to social media .

The announcement comes as officials at the National Weather Service in Louisville predict extreme temperatures throughout the week, with forecasted heat indexes up to 106 degrees, according to a heat advisory issued Aug. 31 .

"Due to forecasted extreme heat this week, ALL outdoor practices and competitions are canceled [Sept. 2 and Sept. 3]," the post states.

Practices and game times for Aug. 31, Sept. 1 and Sept. 4 may also be altered, according to the post. Student athletes are encouraged to check with their coach or athletic director for adjusted times and cancellations.

articles.body:
The transfer window is entering its final stretch!

In France, clubs do not have much time left to wrap up their last signings: the window closes this Tuesday at 7:59 p.m. After that, no more arrivals will be possible, even though sales will still be allowed to leagues where the transfer window remains open.

Among France's European neighbors, it is also coming down to just a few hours. Italy and Germany will close at 8 p.m., while England and Spain will go until midnight. In the Netherlands, the transfer window will continue until Wednesday, in Belgium until Thursday, and in Turkey and Portugal until Friday.

And while Europe will be taking stock, Saudi Arabia will still have time: Saudi clubs will be able to sign players until October 12.

The closing dates and times of the different transfer windows.

Germany and Italy: Tuesday, September 1, 8:00 p.m.

England and Spain: Tuesday, September 1, 12:00 a.m.

Portugal and Turkey: Friday, September 4, 11:59 p.m.

articles.title: Roma boss Gasperini denies possibility of Manu Kone’s late move to Chelsea
articles.summary: Serie A side Roma picked up another convincing 4-0 win today, this time putting away Lecce with ease. Manu Kone, who has been linked with a host of clubs in...
articles.body:
Serie A side Roma picked up another convincing 4-0 win today, this time putting away Lecce with ease. Manu Kone, who has been linked with a host of clubs in England, started the tie and played a key role in the outcome too.

This came hours after Chelsea have been mentioned as possible suitors for the Frenchman today. Kone is said to be viewed as a possible replacement for Enzo Fernandez, who could yet end up at Manchester City.

After the win over Lecce though, Gian Piero Gasperini was asked about the midfielder's future in Rome and if he could yet leave – possibly to Chelsea.

The Italian denied Kone is for sale, shutting down suggestions of a late transfer.

He told the press – via SiamoLaRoma : " Absolutely not, it's a media thing. No one has ever spoken to me about departures, not Koné or anyone else. Especially now, with just 24 hours to go before the transfer window closes."

Gasperini also clarified the Friedkin ownership's stance about Kone's possible exit.

"I also know that the owners aren't in favor of any sales. I don't know who has come forward because we've never received any official offers there either, so this too must be denied."

Gasperini's comments may have been taken with a grain of salt on any other occasion. But besides the lack of time left to find a replacement, he also revealed Roma are still short of numbers in the squad.

He said: "You can't always have Dybala and Malen. Today we only had two players on the bench in attack. We'll have Pellegrini and Rensch back. But you have to remember that there's always someone out. Today we lost Ndicka suddenly."

"Anyone who plays in the Champions League, in particular, must have a strong squad with players who don't feel the impact so severely when you lose someone, as happened last year at a certain point in the season. The owners are certainly putting in the effort, within what they can do, in cutting the number of signings they can achieve."

The Roma boss' comments clearly suggest that if Kone still departs, he could well ask questions of the ownership about the decision. That confrontational approach is almost second nature to the Italian, by now.
